outlook.discussion: 1. Off the East Coast of the United States: A storm-force non-tropical low pressure area is located along a frontal boundary a few hundred miles off the southeast coast of the United States. This low is likely to move slowly and erratically over the next couple of days, and it could gradually acquire subtropical characteristics if it remains over the Gulf Stream. A subtropical cyclone could form during the middle to latter portions of the week when the system begins to move northeastward away from the eastern United States. 1. South of Southern Mexico: Disorganized showers and thunderstorms have persisted with an area of disturbed weather located several hundred miles south of Guatemala. Environmental conditions appear conducive for development, and a tropical depression is expected to form around the middle of this week as the system moves westward to west-northwestward at around 10 mph, well to the south of the coast of southern Mexico. Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...40 percent. Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.
